tool_arguments.summary:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) revenue in Q1 fiscal 2027 (quarter ended August 31, 2026) was $7.4 billion, up 121% year-over-year in U.S. dollars (120% in constant currency). This growth is driven by strong AI infrastructure demand. Oracle's total remaining performance obligations (RPO) stood at $664 billion at the end of Q1 FY2027, an increase of $209 billion year-over-year, reflecting substantial contract backlog including AI-driven commitments. Both figures are sourced from Oracle's Q1 FY2027 earnings release.

Key metrics:
- OCI revenue: $7.4B, +121% YoY (S1.1)
- Total RPO: $664B, +$209B YoY (S2.1)
